hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 1 - Get latest build folder from packager :: ----------------------------------------------- set PACKAGER_BUILDS=%JENKINS_HOME%\..\builds\packager
for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%PACKAGER_BUILDS%' -Directory | Sort-Object Name -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName"') do set LATEST_BUILD=%%I
echo Latest packager build: %LATEST_BUILD%
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 2 - Get JAR from latest build folder :: ----------------------------------------------- for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%LATEST_BUILD%' -Filter *.jar | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName"') do set JAR_PATH=%%I
echo Running JAR: %JAR_PATH%
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 3 - Run the JAR in current job workspace :: ----------------------------------------------- cd "%WORKSPACE%" java -jar "%JAR_PATH%" --PROJECT_ROOT "%WORKSPACE%" --NEI_SDK_BIN "%JENKINS_HOME%\..\cpiozExecuter" --cpioVersion "%cpioVersion%" --scriptName package :: Check if the JAR failed if ERRORLEVEL 1 ( echo Java JAR failed with exit code %ERRORLEVEL%. Aborting build. exit /b %ERRORLEVEL% ) :: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 4 - Get timestamp and commit for new build :: ----------------------------------------------- for /f %%I in ('powershell -command "Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmm"') do set TIMESTAMP=%%I for /f %%I in ('git rev-parse --short HEAD') do set COMMIT=%%I
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 5 - Create output build folder :: ----------------------------------------------- set OUTPUT_BUILDS=%JENKINS_HOME%\..\builds\%JOB_NAME% set DEST=%OUTPUT_BUILDS%\%TIMESTAMP%_%COMMIT%
if not exist "%OUTPUT_BUILDS%" mkdir "%OUTPUT_BUILDS%" mkdir "%DEST%"
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 6 - Copy cpioz output files to build folder :: ----------------------------------------------- if not exist "%DEST%" mkdir "%DEST%" xcopy /I /Y "%WORKSPACE%\*.Z" "%DEST%\" xcopy /I /Y "%WORKSPACE%\*.specification" "%DEST%\"
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 7 - Write info file :: ----------------------------------------------- echo Build Time : %TIMESTAMP% > "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Commit : %COMMIT% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Branch : %GIT_BRANCH% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Job : %JOB_NAME% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Build Number : %BUILD_NUMBER% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo Packager Build: %LATEST_BUILD% >> "%DEST%\info.txt" echo JAR Used : %JAR_PATH% >> "%DEST%\info.txt"
:: ----------------------------------------------- :: STEP 8 - Keep only last 10 builds :: ----------------------------------------------- powershell -command "Get-ChildItem -Path '%OUTPUT_BUILDS%' -Directory | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -SkipLast 10 | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'Deleted old build:' $_.Name }"
echo Done! Output copied to %DEST% type "%DEST%\info.txt"
